## Measurement Notes

- Fill `imagej_area_px2`, `imagej_width_px`, and optionally `imagej_wound_closure_percent` after ImageJ/Wound Healing plugin re-measurement.
- Keep `measurement_status` as `pending`, `measured`, `excluded`, or `needs_review`.
- `hard_case_candidate` rows are included for robustness awareness; they should not be the only basis for the primary Pearson r calculation.
- Unresolved timecourse images are excluded until their handwritten labels/path metadata are manually reconciled.
